prompt: Reference image 1 is a photograph of a man rapping on a rainy San Francisco street corner at night. Keep the photograph exactly as it is: the same camera, framing, street, buildings, light and rain, the same body pose, the same teal hoodie with white drawstrings, tan canvas apron and leather tool belt. Only his head, face, hair, neck and hands change: he is now the man from reference image 2, {desc}, a real adult man with natural human proportions, with the same head position, the same expression and the same mouth shape as in reference image 1, mouth open mid-word, looking straight into the camera. Natural skin texture, raindrops on his face and hair, lit by the same cool white streetlight and colored neon as the rest of the photograph. No text, letters or logos.
cuts_note: On the beat (timing/beats.json, every 0.66 s): S41 on its beats as the street turns real; S42 on its beats, where its glitch already tears the face; S43 ("So which one's singing now?") on half beats, then faster. a, the approved rapper (kept, the human's note), opens S41 as the Act 1 Dev turning real, comes back as S42's face turns into the waveform, and has a close-up in S43 (not next to g, who reads closest to him at a glance); the others appear twice each. v1 gave a only the stand-in and 0.3 s before the waveform.
